name: Conformance: Clarification (nested schema)
description: RFC 0199 §D.2(d) probe. Suspends on a clarification whose one answer is an OBJECT. Bridged as MCP requestedSchema { q1: { type: object, … } } it is not a flat object of primitive properties, so an MCP mount MUST NOT bridge it in form mode (URL mode when the client declared it, else CallToolResult isError). See v2-mcp-mount-map.test.ts.
